subject.title: [Feature]: snapshot-cursor paging for oversized imported CLI transcripts in chat.history

question: Should imported transcript paging extend the existing offset/total contract over a shared snapshot generation, or should opaque cursors become the canonical native `chat.history` paging contract?
rationale: Both approaches solve the missing retrieval path, but they differ in public protocol compatibility, client migration, memory ownership, expiry, invalidation, and stale-page behavior; repository evidence cannot select that permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend existing offsets
options.body: Bind current offset and total metadata to one bounded merged snapshot generation, adding only explicit stale-generation handling where needed.

options.title: Adopt opaque cursors
options.body: Make cursors the canonical native-history contract and migrate local and imported paging together with shared expiry and invalidation semantics.

options.title: Keep imports non-pageable
options.body: Retain terminal-snapshot truncation disclosure and accept that omitted imported rows cannot be retrieved.

recommendation.title: Extend existing offsets
recommendation.body: Bind current offset and total metadata to one bounded merged snapshot generation, adding only explicit stale-generation handling where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both protected design issues and provides the clearest available signal for the permanent protocol choice.
